Speech Recognition Manager Routines

Manipulating Language Objects

The Speech Recognition Manager provides routines that you can use to manipulate language objects. You can use these routines to alter the contents of a language object or to save and load language objects to and from files. See "Creating Language Objects" on page 1-67 for the routines you can use to create language objects.
